dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and continuous reduction in 2D width starting from the mid-dorsal region and narrowing significantly toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor symmetrical indentation visible at the cervical region posterior to the melon; otherwise smooth lateral margins.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-intensity grey with a slight violet-blue chromatic bias; categorized as a non-mature, pigmented skin phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the slightly darker anterior/cephalic region and the lighter dorsal trunk canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Singular high-contrast dark elliptical feature at the blowhole position; faint, low-contrast longitudinal light-colored lines on the right mid-dorsal flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, vertical linear markings on the right dorsal surface, consistent with superficial epidermal abrasions or scratches.
